about: Founder approval gates. Only the founder edits this file. mode: ask (an agent requests approval and waits), allow (no approval needed), off (founder only: agents never do it). paths: files whose change in a pull request needs the founder-approved label. founders: GitHub logins whose words count; empty means the repo owner. review: which role reviews another role's tickets before they can be finished (tickets.py review); a role never reviews its own.

hire.what: Add, remove or change a role or agent, or what it may do

budget.what: Raise a budget, a spending limit or a usage limit

deploy.what: Deploy to production, or change production settings or infrastructure

external.what: Send an email or message, post, or publish anything outside the repo

spend.what: Spend money, start a paid plan, or open an account in the company's name

decision.what: Mark a business, product or engineering decision Approved, or set the company goal, objectives and key results

plan.what: Start work on a parent ticket's plan: its sub-tickets can't be claimed until the founder approves the plan

pricing.what: Set or change prices, discounts or terms offered to customers

legal.what: Accept terms, sign anything, or make a legal, compliance or certification claim

secrets.what: Create, view or change secrets, keys, wallets or credentials
